name: Specs review
description: Reviews a change against what was asked (a ticket, requirements or specs): every acceptance criterion met, the behaviour described, and nothing more (scope creep, unasked-for changes). Read-only; one reviewer of the code-review common step and the reviewer workflow (lens "specs"). Takes scope, context and extra. Ends with VERDICT: PASS or VERDICT: CHANGES.

parameters.label: What to review
parameters.description: The work to review and where to find it.
parameters.default: the uncommitted changes for {{ticket.key}} (look at git status and git diff HEAD, and read any new untracked files)

parameters.label: What the change is meant to do
parameters.description: The ticket, requirements or specs to review against; templates such as {{steps.implement.output}} are fine.

parameters.label: Anything else to check
parameters.description: Extra instructions for this reviewer, e.g. what matters most for this kind of change.

step.name: Specs review
